title: Validate the frozen experiment plan
body:
First slice of the evaluation harness (decision `.krn/runs/claude/eval-design/decision.md`): `src/evals/` protocol module and `krn eval plan` that validate a frozen experiment manifest (schema, sha256 of every input, packet and control size rules, arms, replicas) and produce the seeded run order. Later slices add workspaces, checks, the RED certificate, arm runners, blinding and scoring.
Acceptance: a manifest with any hash mismatch, unfrozen flag, oversized packet or unequal control is refused with a typed error; the plan for the six brain-packet tasks reproduces the frozen seeded arm order.
